name: Nakazawa Nodoka
source:
The queen of the SM club "Combat de Reines", Nodoka is Reines' most longtime employee. She commands all the other slaves.

She has a magnanimous "everyone's onee-san" type personality.

[translated from [url=http://www.scarecrow.co.jp/abp/mxs/txt_char.htm]official site[/url]]
